cpp_engine_policy: C++ engine/runtime first. Automatic host-local backend selection is owned by the C++ executable storagellm_host_autotune.
python_policy: Python is not the runtime orchestrator. It remains only where unavoidable for pip and TVM Python API codegen helpers: scripts/install_tvm_dependency.py and moe_engine/backends/tvm_codegen/*.py.
cmake_policy: CMake is build configuration only. Default path is automatic; users do not manually choose backend options.
default_entry: apply_patch.ps1 configures CMake, builds storagellm_host_autotune, runs C++ host autotune, writes build/selected_backend.env, then builds the project.
colab_policy: preserved only; colab is not treated as the target runtime environment.
truth: C++ auto pipeline is wired and fail-closed. Native CUTLASS/Metal/Vulkan/OpenCL/ROCm MoE kernels are not counted as complete unless implemented, built, and measured on the user's machine.
bottleneck_fixes: CPU native grouped-MoE split into tensor-view, activation, assignment-kernel, and parallel modules so one file is not doing every role.
CPU native path reuses one mid buffer per worker instead of allocating std::vector<float> per assignment.
CPU native path uses contiguous chunk scheduling and OpenMP runtime pooling when available, with thread fallback otherwise.
CPU dot loops are unrolled by 4 for the gate/up and down projections.
CMake enables host-native optimization for local C++ CPU kernels by default during the automatic build.
CUDA/cuBLASLt path now uses a thread-local reusable device workspace instead of cudaMalloc/cudaFree for every invocation.
C++ autotune measurement now uses warmup plus adaptive iterations instead of a tiny fixed iteration count.
